observed_failure.evidence: The versioned PhysioNet SHA256 manifest resolver returned no complete verified baseline+cognitive_load pair for participant 3, so the job stopped before either source file pair was accepted.
observed_failure.result_exposure: Participant 3 produced no Python-oracle result, no Kotlin result, no parity result, and no endpoint value. No WF02 group statistic has been computed or inspected. Completed participants' endpoint values have not been inspected.

preregistration_alignment.frozen_rule: A pair is analyzable only if both verified source files satisfy the frozen input mapping. Any NOT_ANALYZABLE participant and exact reason are retained in the group artifact. Primary inference uses all analyzable preregistered participant pairs.
preregistration_alignment.implementation_gap: The first implementation hard-failed the matrix job when a checksum-manifest entry was unavailable and the aggregate code incorrectly required 11 subject.json files, preventing the preregistered NOT_ANALYZABLE path from being represented.
preregistration_alignment.correction: Implement the already-frozen NOT_ANALYZABLE path. A participant lacking either verified checksum-manifest source identity is retained as NOT_ANALYZABLE with exact reason; no substitute recording or window is used. Aggregate inference requires a status artifact for every preregistered id 0..10 and uses only ANALYZABLE matched pairs.
